mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mobile_auth_session ( user_id, installation_id, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, previous_refresh_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, created_at, revoked_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{installationId}, #{accessTokenHash}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{previousRefreshTokenHash}, #{accessExpiresAt}, #{refreshExpiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{revokedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, installation_id, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, previous_refresh_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, created_at, revoked_at FROM mobile_auth_session WHERE access_token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND access_expires_at > #{now} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, installation_id, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, previous_refresh_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, created_at, revoked_at FROM mobile_auth_session WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{tokenHash} OR previous_refresh_token_hash = #{tokenHash} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, user_id, installation_id, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, previous_refresh_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, created_at, revoked_at FROM mobile_auth_session WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT session_id FROM mobile_refresh_token_history WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mobile_refresh_token_history (session_id, token_hash, used_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{usedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE mobile_auth_session SET access_token_hash = #{accessTokenHash}, refresh_token_hash = #{refreshTokenHash}, previous_refresh_token_hash = #{previousRefreshTokenHash}, access_expires_at = #{accessExpiresAt}, refresh_expires_at = #{refreshExpiresAt}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
